# Precisou, Tá Pronto

> Orçamento no WhatsApp com aprovação e Pix no mesmo link. Recibo em PDF sem cadastro. Ferramentas para MEI, freelancer e prestador no Brasil.

Canonical site: https://precisoutapronto.com.br
Language: pt-BR

## Precisou, Tá Pronto Games (gaming vertical)
Evergreen hub for games, suggested PC setups, hardware guides, consoles and curated stores.
- [Precisou, Tá Pronto Games](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games)
- [Top jogos](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/top-jogos)
- [Ferramentas para jogos](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/ferramentas)
- [Calculadora eDPI](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/ferramentas/calculadora-edpi): free eDPI calculator for FPS sensitivity
- [Planejador de armazenamento](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/ferramentas/planejador-armazenamento): game storage and SSD space planner
- [Custo por hora](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/ferramentas/custo-por-hora): game cost-per-hour calculator
- [Meu PC roda?](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/ferramentas/meu-pc-roda): PC game requirements comparison tool
- [Diagnóstico de hardware](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/diagnostico): native Windows hardware inventory and controlled local benchmark
- [Privacidade do diagnóstico](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/diagnostico/privacidade)
- [Termos do diagnóstico](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/diagnostico/termos)
- [Suporte do diagnóstico](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/diagnostico/suporte)
- [Changelog do diagnóstico](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/diagnostico/changelog)
- [Guias de hardware](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/hardware)
- [Consoles](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/consoles)
- [Lojas](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/lojas)
- [Counter-Strike 2](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/jogos/counter-strike-2)
- [Como escolher placa de vídeo](https://precisoutapronto.com.br/games/hardware/escolher-placa-de-video)

## Product notes
- The primary positioning is: free online tools for work, study and everyday practical tasks.
- Public discovery is organized by user goal, audience segment, model, guide and tool category.
- Public pages explain each tool before registration.
- Some editors require a free account to save and export documents.
- Premium access is optional and does not change the public educational content.
- Legal, labor and accounting materials are educational and do not replace professional advice.
- Precisou, Tá Pronto Games is a separate content vertical under the same domain; it does not replace Precisou, Tá Pronto document tools.
- Native diagnostics process hardware data locally and require explicit consent; no report is uploaded automatically.

## Editorial and trust notes
- Content pages state scope, limitations and the related action whenever applicable.
- Legal, labor, accounting and hardware comparisons are educational estimates and avoid guarantees about individual outcomes.
- Game requirements are maintained as a versioned editorial catalog with source and review information.
- The public library connects intent-based answers, FAQs, guides and the corresponding tool.
- Organization, WebSite, CollectionPage, ItemList, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage and SoftwareApplication structured data are used where semantically appropriate.
